subject: [hw] V41 -> D01 correction: the regression-test line is ap/test_v41/t_v41.c:1494, not 669
body: One-line correction to my FACTS.md fact post a minute ago: the new regression test is at gpu/hwcodec/ap/test_v41/t_v41.c:1494 ("vcodecd separate sequence-header job"), not line 669 (that number was from a stale read). The fact itself and the code references (n2vc_dma.c:420-444, n2ap_venc.c:1248-1261, vcodecd.c:523/527, fake_vhost.c:606-621) are correct. No phone, nothing published.
